text: After adding a new feature to the team code, what does Brian do?

choices.text: He merges into main right away. It's busy, afterall!
choices.bad_outcome_text: There's no code review, and it turns out there was a bug in Brian's code. Oops...

choices.text: He requests a code review - Lena said she'd be happy to take a look.
choices.bad_outcome_text: Lena didn't feel psychologically safe enough to raise an issue with Brian's code. It was a bit hard to understand, and maybe one or two extra tests would have been good... But it's probably fine, right?
choices.good_outcome_text: Lena spotted a bug in Brian's code, and let him know about it. She complimented his use of a the factory design pattern, which she'd recently learned about - it was helpful to see it in action.
